In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the male population is more interested in product information whereas female population is more interested to know about the shipping and payment methods.
, for the female segment, the most important factor is the product description and the least important is the payment option.

, for males the most important factor for an ecommerce website is ‘Product Price’ followed by ‘Product Quality’ and ‘Website Design’, whereas for females, ‘Product Quality’ is most important, followed by ‘Website Design’ and ‘Product Price’.
